name: Get a pass installation URL for a contact
description: Get a pass installation URL for a contact. Generate a wallet installation URL for a specific contact. The returned URL points to the pass installation page and encodes the pass, contact and organization identifiers as an encrypted token, so it can be shared with the contact (email, SMS, QR code, ...) to add the pass to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.

passId.description: Pass ID. The unique identifier of the wallet pass for which to generate an installation URL.

contactId.description: The Brevo contact ID the installation URL is generated for.

url.description: The wallet installation URL for the contact. Opening it lets the contact add the pass to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.

verification.notes: Generated from the public OpenAPI spec. Not executed.
